unit.why: A single anecdote, told by the Neskhizer rebbe, about the Apter Rav in Berdichev telling an exaggerated tale about a bridge in Iasi and a merchant who 'confirmed' it.

stories.start_quote: עוד סיפר הרה״ק מנעסכיז שבהיות האפטר בבארדיטשוב
stories.end_quote: מנין אתם יודעים זה בדרך תימה
stories.summary_en: While in Berdichev, surrounded by a crowd, the Apter Rav drinks brandy and tells a hugely exaggerated story about a bridge built before his house in Iasi; when the merchant R. Noah nods and confirms it, the Apter turns to him in surprise and asks how he could know.

tags.why: Framed as told by the Neskhizer rebbe, and the Apter himself tells a tale
The tsaddik tells a deliberately exaggerated, jesting tale

tags.why: The merchant falsely confirms an obvious exaggeration, and the Apter exposes it
